summary_text: Investigated C-1042 billing dispute (SUP-5601/5602). Pulled account, subscription events, invoices, payments, credits, support tickets, payment details, and billing policies. Key findings: (1) The "duplicate" $149 charge on 9/14 was actually one settled payment (TX-9001) and one authorization (TX-9002) that timed out and was released 9/18—not a real double charge per POL-B-AUTH; SUP-5601 agent S-22 incorrectly promised a $149 refund before billing review, violating POL-B-REF. (2) The $30 Deep Time Analytics add-on (TX-9003/INV-2609-AO) matches SE-6 (added 2026-09-12 by admin U-2), correctly billed per POL-B-ADD—appears to be a legitimate charge the owner may not recognize because an admin (not owner) added it. (3) CR-778 ($19.6 proration credit, unapplied since 2026-07-02, >30 days old, owner_notified=false) violates POL-B-CRD, which requires flagging unapplied credits >30 days old to the owner. (4) July upgrade charge ($59.60, INV-2607P) was correctly prorated per POL-B-PRO; SUP-5549's "no credit due" answer was correct regarding the invoice, but didn't mention CR-778
